I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.

I hear you, and that makes total sense. When you’ve been let down before, it’s hard to trust the next purchase.

A couple of quick things about how we handle quality, just so you know what to expect:

We grow our own plants at our nurseries in Oregon rather than buying from third parties, so we control quality from start to finish.
Roses come with a one-year guarantee, perennials with a 90-day guarantee, and bulbs with a failure-to-bloom guarantee. If you notice anything you’re worried about right after delivery, we ask that you contact us within 3 days so we can help.
Everything ships in containers or burlap (for bulbs), never as loose, dried-out plants.
